smoke.notes: Offline skips the 2 live-channel checks (19 live). Two local fixes were needed, no network used: (1) missing 'yaml' dep satisfied by symlink download/node_modules/yaml -> quilt-dba/node_modules/yaml; (2) the run rewrites lab/outputs/*, so committed outputs were restored with git checkout -- lab/outputs afterwards. Harness includes independent reference stack agreement to 1e-9, no-lookahead probe, both veto paths, chain re-derivation + tamper break, analyst letter-fence vs adversarial digest.

essence: Trading desk as closed-loop cell sheet: simulate first, gated learning, receipts.

ideas.name: The sheet is the agent, not a calculator
ideas.statement: A reactive cell graph (vendored patched quilt engine) hosts perception, beliefs, world, gates and ledger as cells; the human only watches. One value push re-prices the whole desk.

ideas.name: Simulate first, confirm before action
ideas.statement: No proposal becomes an action without passing the world (full backtest receipt) and the M5 rails: dd-halt, overtrade brake, vol stress, resonance agreement, entanglement veto.

ideas.name: Learn strictly, prune relentlessly
ideas.statement: Quantum-entropy perturbation accepted only on strict score improvement; weights that never matter (7+ tries, <0.02 max delta) go dormant — the agent gets simpler over time.

ideas.name: The LLM enters through a letter fence
ideas.statement: The analyst sees a <=600-char digest and answers one letter A-E; the letter decodes to an action that still goes through the same gates. A bad pick costs a refuse receipt, not the desk.

ideas.name: Independent evidence everywhere
ideas.statement: A separately-written quant stack cross-checks the sheet to 1e-9; every learning step lands in an fnv1a64 witness chain that re-derives and breaks loudly on one flipped byte.

parts.name: Vendored patched quilt engine
parts.essence: The reactive cell graph (arcade lineage, patches 1-12) with effectful invalidation and fresh-by-default program cells; zero further engine changes.
parts.gate: If a quant check fails it is the sheet's fault, not the engine's (engine frozen, verified against 36 upstream tests)
parts.failure_mode: Engine drift would invalidate every cross-check; prevented by vendoring verbatim

parts.name: Belief cells and the one tape
parts.essence: 10 visible w.* belief value cells + w.state (participation/dormancy/champion) and mkt.ohlcv, 240 seeded bars — the only input (M1); mkt.truth is hidden and policy never reads it.
outputs: belief state readable by proposal and learning cells
parts.gate: Tape shorter than 60 bars or containing a non-finite positive bar halts everything (M1)
parts.failure_mode: NaN bar poisons downstream — harness proves M1 halts on it

parts.name: Waveform perception
parts.essence: Goertzel power at periods 8-64 over returns, dominant period P*, sin/cos resonance projection, trend R2; recovers the hidden 41/13-bar cycles exactly via greedy non-adjacent peak picking.
outputs: wave.spectrum {p_star, ratio, amp, phase, slope, r2}
parts.gate: Indicators may be null while warming up — nulls mean FLAT, never a guess
parts.failure_mode: Window leakage fakes neighbor peaks without non-adjacent picking

parts.name: The world: sim.run publishes a receipt
parts.essence: Full backtest of the CURRENT beliefs (entries at close, 6bps fees, no leverage, stops/targets/ATR, cycle expiry), publishing sim.last with a hash; analytics are formulas over the receipt.
parts.gate: No lookahead: bar i may only see bars <= i (truncated-tape policy replay probe)
parts.failure_mode: Lookahead silently inflates Sharpe — probed by mutating bar 400

parts.name: Moth-entropy learning step
parts.essence: learn.step perturbs two weights per round (least-tried non-meta + moth-random) using qpixl shot-noise floats via moth.pool/moth.cursor, re-runs the world, keeps only strict improvements.
outputs: updated w.* or a refusal row in ledger.rows
parts.gate: Accept iff score = sharpe - 2*maxdd - 0.5*[trades<3] strictly improves
parts.failure_mode: Noise-chasing would degrade the desk — refusals are receipts, not losses

parts.name: M8 dormancy (pruning)
parts.essence: A weight that across 7+ tries never moves the score by >= 0.02 goes DORMANT: frozen at value, removed from the search, receipted; meta-knob w.step_scale exempt.
parts.gate: Dormancy requires >= 7 tries AND max delta < 0.02 — decided from data, not luck
parts.failure_mode: Premature freezing would lose latent weights; the try-count floor guards

parts.name: Two-block edge-triggered proposal
parts.essence: TREND block (sma-gap x momentum-z) and CYCLE block (rsi extreme aligned with price-wave phase at P*) vote only on FRESH crossings; disagreement yields a CONFLICT block at strength 0.5; every proposal carries its reason.
parts.gate: Edge-trigger: the vote must be absent on the previous bar (a signal is an event, not a state)
parts.failure_mode: Held-state voting would overtrade — the harness audits proposal structure

parts.name: M5 confirmation rails
parts.essence: gateLite vetoes inside the simulation loop: dd-halt 12%, overtrade brake 8 changes/20 bars, vol-z cap, cycle entries need the price-wave behind them, trend SHORT against TREND_UP at strength < 0.8.
parts.gate: A proposal acts only if every rail returns null — verdict lists its checks
parts.failure_mode: Each rail is individually falsifiable; harness fires dd-halt and veto paths explicitly

parts.name: Entanglement veto
parts.essence: When the quantum graph read (graph-v1 tomography, 4 feature qubits, ZZ couplings) reports |ZZ| >= 0.82 between momentum and mean-reversion, a CONFLICT proposal is refused: the signals are locked, not independent.
parts.failure_mode: Live run measured ZZ -0.937 naive vs -0.028 learned; threshold is a demo constant (honest limit)

parts.name: Analyst letter fence
parts.essence: ai.digest compresses distributed state to <=600 chars; ai.analyst (typed ai cell) must answer ONE letter A-E (keep/explore/exploit/prune/re-tune); the fence lives between model and sheet, mock is state-reactive and labeled.
inputs: regime, scores, dormant set, ZZ read, weights
outputs: letter -> bounded action (e.g. step_scale scaling, force-prune)
parts.gate: Reply must decode to exactly one of A-E — anything else is REFUSED with a reason
parts.failure_mode: An adversarial digest cannot push the analyst outside the fence (harness check)

parts.name: Moth-quantum client with cell-level honesty
parts.essence: submit -> poll -> result client for coin-toss-v1, qpixl-v1, graph-v1; every call receipted in moth.journal; offline mode swaps synthetic data flagged mock:true at the cell level — the sheet never knows, the audience always does.
outputs: entropy floats, waveform drift, ZZ tomography
parts.gate: Every API call must land in moth.journal; offline substitutions must be labeled mock:true
parts.failure_mode: Unlabeled mock data would fake quantum provenance

parts.name: Glass: lamp, listener and sparkline
parts.essence: sig.lamp shows the gate verdict, lamp.gate listener announces confirmations, art.equity renders the equity curve as a unicode sparkline — the cells themselves rendered for the audience.
parts.failure_mode: A silent gate would hide refusals; the lamp makes every verdict watchable

parts.name: Independent reference stack
parts.essence: The harness carries its own quant stack (prefix-sum SMAs, delta-array Wilder RSI, settlement accounting, independent DFT) written separately from the sheet kernel, cross-checked to 1e-9 including the full trade sequence.
parts.gate: Return/Sharpe/maxdd/exposure and trade sequence must match the reference to 1e-9
parts.failure_mode: Any kernel drift between sheet and reference fails the harness loudly

parts.name: Witness chain over learning rounds
parts.essence: ledger.rows is an fnv1a64 chain (one row per round, GENESIS-rooted); the harness re-derives it and proves one flipped byte breaks it at the flipped position.
parts.gate: Chain re-derivation must succeed; tampering must break it visibly
parts.failure_mode: Silent history edits — caught by hash mismatch at the flipped byte

cells.expr: {tries, wins, maxd per weight, dormant, champion, best_score}
policyAt(i,...) — trend + cycle blocks, edge-triggered, conflict at 0.5 (SRC_POLICY)
full backtest of current beliefs, M1-M6, publishes receipt
published world receipt {metrics, trades, halt, hash}
M5 rails incl. gateLite vetoes + entanglement veto
perturb 2 weights from moth.pool, accept iff strictly better (M7/M8)
fnv1a64 chain, one row per round, GENESIS-rooted
typed ai.llm cell fenced to ONE letter A-E

layer_logic.0: The substrate is a frozen reactive cell graph (patches 1-12) plus visible belief/value cells — understanding is distributed across the graph, never in one cell.
layer_logic.1: Mechanisms transform tape -> waveform -> proposal -> world receipt -> accepted weight deltas; the simulation itself is the architecture's central transformation.
layer_logic.2: Policy is a stack of named refusals: edge-trigger precondition, five M5 rails, the |ZZ| entanglement admission, strict-improvement admission, dormancy admission, and the letter fence for the LLM.
layer_logic.3: Interfaces are the moth-quantum client (mock-labeled at cell level), the lamp/announcer/glass for the audience, and the ai cell typed through patch-8 schema passthrough.
layer_logic.4: Evidence is a second, independently-written quant stack agreeing to 1e-9, plus an fnv1a64 witness chain that re-derives and breaks loudly — every refusal is a receipt, not a loss.
